title: net1 v6's capacity belief on a shared link
description: Rules on the true LCFs fail among copies, and the learned net2 r18e05 with the true capacity in place of net1's collapses as copies (-1.247, exp-net2-patch-v6-172): each copy aims at the whole link. Local runs on net1 v4 put its capacity belief on a shared link at 0.4 to 0.9 of the link. This measures it for net1 v6: the fixed rule on net1 v6 (u = 0.25) and BBRv3, alone and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s on the validation links (campaign seed 11), with the observations kept, and experiments/belief_share.py reports the median believed capacity over the link's capacity and over the fair share (capacity over the number of flows), with the flow's receive rate beside them.
prepare: N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 1 2 4 --stock bbr3 --policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; cp "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
